## Description

Applies Graph Attention Networks to asset correlation graphs to enforce eigenvalue spectral clipping and conditioning regularization on rolling covariance matrices.

## Where it may fit

High-dimensional Markowitz portfolio optimization, illiquid asset covariance matrix conditioning.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Risk-Parity Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Rolling asset return covariance matrices, fundamental factor panels, sector taxonomies.

## Caveats

Spectral eigenvalue decomposition layers must maintain numerical stability during backpropagation.
